title: Skingrip
summary: Skingrip is a spell that restricts the movement of the enemy. The target is wrapped from head to toe in a yellow, mummy cloth-like energy that can temporarily ensnare and halt the opponent. If the target is experienced with spells or possesses great physical strength, it is possible for the bonds to be broken.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Skingrip was used by [[the Professor]], through the conduit of his [[Ring]] of [[Araknos]], to temporarily bind [[Montehue]] while in [[King Solomon's mines]]. {{source|To Be Together}} The Professor also used the spell to bind [[Sophie Casterwill]], however it wore off almost immediately, for reasons unknown. {{source|The Mission}}

[[Tantras]] used the spell on [[Harrison Fears]] during a training session in the [[Blood Spiral Base]]. He later used it on both [[Dante Vale]] and his own students, before attempting to hit them all with a [[Bladewave]] spell. [[Sophie Casterwill]]'s [[Honorguard]] intervention caused the spell to rebound, sending them flying in all directions. {{Source|Boys Will Be Seekers}}

full_text:
Skingrip is a spell that restricts the movement of the enemy. The target is wrapped from head to toe in a yellow, mummy cloth-like energy that can temporarily ensnare and halt the opponent. If the target is experienced with spells or possesses great physical strength, it is possible for the bonds to be broken.

== History ==
Skingrip was used by the Professor, through the conduit of his Ring of Araknos, to temporarily bind Montehue while in King Solomon's mines. [To Be Together] The Professor also used the spell to bind Sophie Casterwill, however it wore off almost immediately, for reasons unknown. [The Mission]

Tantras used the spell on Harrison Fears during a training session in the Blood Spiral Base. He later used it on both Dante Vale and his own students, before attempting to hit them all with a Bladewave spell. Sophie Casterwill's Honorguard intervention caused the spell to rebound, sending them flying in all directions. [Boys Will Be Seekers]
